Aina Winchester is a recurring character in the Taimanin Online Games, and is playable in Action Taimanin.

A firearms expert and freelance mercenary, Aina is a normal human but has been given a demonic eye after an event in her childhood. Aina typically works alone or with UFS Forces because of her past, but is not part of their army, as such she at times crosses paths with Taimanins and helps out if the pay is good or innocent people need help.



Personality
Although she's a cool-headed and easy-going woman, behind that she's motivated by her desire to kill the demons that killed her family and took her eye at a young age.

Aina, is typically flexible enough to work with criminals as long as they are not legitimately dangerous. Can hold a grudge if wronged and will pursue people, even if less significant than the demons she's looking for.

This has led her to be a lone wolf type who is always on her guard, serious and alert at all times. Aina will often claim her "real motivation" to be money, though this seems to be more an act, and she will often help out regardless because she is a good person at heart. She can act very masculine, but has also a shy side when it comes to dressing up revealing or romantic topics. Aina also loves children and has given to communities in need.

Her favorite hobbies are weight training, shooting and cleaning her firearms. Her favorite foods are nutrition bars and milk, giving this food she might be unhappy with her size, though she has not voiced that worry as often as other characters and seems not to have a complex.

Had at times contact with Koukawa Asuka, and has been asked about Kotaro.


Appearance
She has short white hair, a blue eye and an enormous bust, with equally enormous thick legs and thighs. She has an eye patch with an artificial amber eye below. Aina is a very short woman, regardless of her proportions.

Furthermore, she wears a purple trench coat with belts, with a cleavage that barely contains her breasts, the clothes even showing signs of being stretched and could rip at any point. Besides, she also wears a coat that shows signs of wear and tear, with white cotton on the sleeves and around the neck as well, that cover a small choker. Finally, she wears dark stockings with military boots. She carries a pair of guns in holsters on her sides. Her overall color palette is purple themed.

History
Aina Winchester
Background
A human mercenary with a demonic eye, she keeps hidden.

In her youth, she lived a normal life in the UFS. The Winchester's family is an old American family, with ties into UFS/USA politics, with members being part of United States Congress for hundreds of years. At a young age, her parents were killed by demons in front of her, and she suffered from a trauma. Aina, in turn, was tortured by the Demon Tribe and her eye was gouged out. However, she was saved by arriving, UFS soldiers and was given a demonic eye prosthetic, as part of an experiment. With no close relatives, she became an orphan and was entrusted to an orphanage for the rest of her youth. Aina eventually became more and more driven by revenge and joined a UFS military academy, as she desired to take down the demons responsible.

However, when graduating, she did not join the army. Instead, she became a lone hunter, chasing the monsters that killed her parents and making a living as a mercenary. The weapons she obtains can be boosted with her vampiric demonic eye, this eye comes with a danger of her own Demonization, so Aina avoids over doing its use. Thanks to her academy-trained fighting skills, she defeated numerous demons and has, earned quite a reputation in the UFS military. She is now loosely affiliated with them and uses her tools to accomplish missions for the UFS, at times she also confronts the Taimanin.

Timeline TABA
Aina Winchester 4
She had a rotten relationship with Kotaro thanks to a fake marriage he blackmailed her into. She plans to take revenge for it someday, but she is very easy-going, and at the next time she meets him, Fuuma's deep kiss makes her fall easily for him.

Later on, while in Japan in an UFS base, she is called to protect another base that is currently researching Luna, which had been recaptured from the Fuuma Organization. She ends up fighting against Kotaro and his group, supported by Renee. However, after her defeat, Kotaro suggest she should just join him. Although refusing at first, she afterward states that she works only for the UFS as long as her current mission is ongoing, open the possibility that she joined him on a contract basis.

Otherwise, an alternative "What If" shows her been defeated and tortured by a group of demons. Her prosthetic eye, as it turns out, might be made from hell technology, as suggested by a dark energy that starts to fill Aina.

Timeline RPGX
Aina Winchester Bride
Can be hired by the Independent Rangers.

Appeared in the event "Dangerous Summer Beach". As a member of the UFS side, she cooperates with Fuuma Kotaro and deepens their connection, while working together to solve the mystery of the disappearance, she uses her demonic eye during that time to defeat Succubus Brave Lilim upgraded version and cure herself of a demonic qi. She later shows up at the orphanage, making the children happy as Santa.

Appeared as the main character in the event "Immortal Soldier". She received information that certain illegal research was being conducted at the pharmaceutical company Arkham Bio, and out of anger infiltrated on his own. She saved Nakamori Nanaka, and together they defeated Hans Eduard Victor, which had used Nanaka's blood to become immortal.

After that, Asuka asked her about her interactions with Fuuma, since she only knew stuff from casual remarks, and she talked about everything that had happened so far. She also visited the liquor store run by Sana, Izakaya Sana.

Would again be on the beach, having a vacation during the Tacobozu incident, would meet Carla Cromwell and was introduced.

Timeline Action
Aina Winchester 5
Came into a short conflict with the Taimanin Task Force but is not working against them. Can join the Task Force as a supporter.

Aina is now a playable character in the game. She was hired by leftovers of Momochi Toyo former group, and defeated by Fuuma Kotaro. To avoid serious consequences, she was given the DSO and now works with them and the Task Force.


Powers/Abilities
Aina Ultimate
Main Weapon: Dual Laser Pistol (Type Zero)

Fire Weapon Expert: Her weapon Type, Zero, is able to shoot lasers but also switch into a laser sword mode. A full-burst mode synchronizes with Aina's eye to increase the strength but is linked to her emotions. Prefers to fight long distance, but in a pinch can also fight in close combat situations. Her weapons also have additional Holographic Displays to improve her already great aim.
Military Training: Very well-trained and able to keep up even with Taimanin.
Explosives
Drone User: Uses at times Drone Orbiters.
Artificial Eye: Yellow eye with demonic powers that can boost her abilities, but has a corrupting effect on her which is currently not fully understood. Her eye activates magic abilities and boosts her weapons, but require her blood to activate. Constant use of them will eventually cause anemia as a side effect.

Trivia
Her favorite foods are dietary supplements and milk.
Her parents are alive in the TABA timeline and mentioned in one of the "what if" events. However, the same "what if" in RPGX which is reused, changed this to be distant relatives.
Height here is assumed from comparing character heights in Action Taimanin, with known character sizes and might not reflect the true height. She has the shortest playable character model in the game, and is a few cm smaller than even Aishu Hebiko and Noah Brown.
TABA Artbook 1 and 4 gives additional information and states that her eye is from a vampire.
